findings_and_questions.trigger_and_effect: On each qualifying positive terrain penetration, the client scales x/z velocity by terrain_horizontal_velocity_retention; system is in Update. For the same starting velocity and a fixed retention fraction, N qualifying passes yield fraction^N before other effects. Different qualifying pass counts can therefore change retained velocity over the same elapsed time. Muscles/damping are scheduled separately in FixedUpdate. This follows from source and arithmetic, not a runtime experiment; Update counts and collision sequence are not assumed equal or independently measured.

Confirm whether the desired visual grounding policy is frame-dependent or elapsed-time based and how to handle missing/ambiguous terrain; do not label a gameplay strategic/tactical authority issue.

findings_and_questions.trigger_and_effect: Rise and limp duration are finite nonnegative elapsed values; for either value below 0.001 seconds the respective denominator is 0.001, including zero.
